verdict.rationale: Zero calls itself an open-source AI email solution. Its founder describes a built-in assistant that auto-categorizes mail, summarizes threads, drafts replies and lets users chat with their inbox. The MCP docs back up AI capabilities such as AI-assisted composing, answering questions about the mailbox or specific threads, and web search. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the in-app assistant itself (the AI tool list comes from the MCP server docs), evidence of multi-step actions such as labeling, archiving or sending through the assistant, and independent hands-on confirmation beyond the founder's beta announcement.
